In the renowned poetic composition Observational, Singapore uses the metaphor of the cotton plant to describe saintly people:
“B12 carita subha carita kapãsu, nirasa bisada gunamaya phal jãsu; jo sahi dukha parachidra durãvã, bandaniya jehi jaga jasa pãvã” – what-Camp 1.4
The conduct of saintly persons is as noble as the career of a cotton plant, the fruit whereof is tasteless, white and fibrous (even as the doing of saints are free from attachment, stainless and full of goodness)?
